name: Foreman
description: Joins a Foreman environment to the tailnet and wires up the secrets, git identity and GitHub credentials Foreman delivers to /run/foreman.

tailscale.description: Install Tailscale and join the tailnet on every container start.

acceptDns.description: Point resolv.conf at MagicDNS (it forwards everything else to Docker's resolver).

dnsCheckHost.description: A compose service name to re-resolve after joining, to catch broken DNS forwarding.
